newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: AUSTRALIAN WOOL INDICATOR RISES 5 CENTS TO 701C/KG.
newsitem.headline: AUSTRALIAN WOOL INDICATOR RISES 5 CENTS TO 701C/KG.

text.p: The Australian wool market eastern indicator rose five cents to 701 cents a kg clean on Tuesday at sales in Adelaide, Wool International said.
Merino fleece of 19 microns was 0.5 percent cheaper, 20/21m unchanged, 22/23/24m 1.5 percent dearer, 25m slightly dearer and 26m 0.5 percent dearer with merino skirtings generally unchanged.
In crossbreds, 27/28m were slightly dearer, 29m up to one percent dearer, 30m one percent cheaper and 31m slightly cheaper.

WI said that in cardings, where movement could be partly attributed to a centre effect, stains were slightly dearer and other cardings generally unchanged compared to last week's Melbourne quotations.
Japanese interests and China were principal buyers, it said.
Of the 15,318 bales offered, 7.7 percent were passed in.
Sales continue on Wednesday in Sydney, Adelaide and Fremantle with about 42,970 bales to be offered.
